analysis.summary: Rivals are pushing AI-ready infrastructure. Flexential also leans on VMware help guides. TierPoint mostly refreshes service pages and has little guide or research content.

points.text: Flexential published 16 new pages, mostly how-to guides on VMware, backup and hybrid cloud. It also removed 17 old pages. That looks like a rebuild.
Digital Realty ties nearly everything to AI: 28 updated pages and 9 new ones, mostly thought leadership. TierPoint has one AI piece.
TierPoint's 15 active pages are mostly service pages. Digital Realty and Flexential also publish research that TierPoint doesn't.

TierPoint.play: Refreshes core service pages (DRaaS, VMware, Nutanix, public cloud) and adds a few new pieces on cost, AI and risk.

Digital Realty.play: Frames colocation as the base for private AI, with cooling, interconnection and research to back it.

Flexential.play: Rebuilds its library with VMware VCF 9, backup and hybrid cloud guides, plus a '96%' network study.

Rackspace Technology.play: Mass-publishes copies of three themes: healthcare cloud, sovereignty and cyber risk. Treat as one bulk launch.

CoreSite.play: Publishes small amounts on community, careers, satellite links and cloud direct connect costs.
CoreSite.aimed: Local communities, job seekers, network buyers

Expedient.play: Publishes almost nothing new: two webinar pages on Nutanix multi-tenant and AI CTRL.

shared.title: AI infrastructure story
shared.text: Digital Realty and Flexential push AI-ready infrastructure, covering power, cooling and network limits. TierPoint has one such piece, so it is behind on this topic.

shared.title: Cost and CapEx/OpEx framing
shared.text: Each publishes on cloud cost: TierPoint's CapEx vs OpEx, Digital Realty's IT modernization, Flexential's TCO (total cost of ownership) pieces. Buyers want money arguments, and rivals are making them.

shared.title: Service page refresh push
shared.text: All three updated core pages like colocation and DRaaS (disaster recovery as a service). Digital Realty updated 28 older pages, Flexential 24, TierPoint 9. This is upkeep more than new ideas.

gaps.title: Nutanix vs VMware guide
gaps.text: Flexential owns VMware exit and pricing help. Expedient only has a Nutanix webinar. TierPoint runs managed Nutanix and VMware and could write the neutral comparison.

gaps.title: Original research
gaps.text: Digital Realty has 3 research pages and Flexential 2. TierPoint has none. A survey of IT buyers could earn press and trust.

gaps.title: Healthcare cloud and compliance
gaps.text: Only Rackspace covers it in depth, and its output is bulk copies. Flexential has one healthcare page. TierPoint could publish real, specific guides.

versus.Digital Realty: Publishes far more thought leadership and research on AI infrastructure, while TierPoint leans on service pages and has one AI architecture piece.
versus.Flexential: Publishes many practical how-to guides and comparisons, with more new pages than TierPoint's 6, where TierPoint mainly updates service pages.
versus.Rackspace Technology: Has huge page volume, but it is repeated content on three themes. TierPoint publishes fewer, more varied pages.
versus.CoreSite: Focuses on community and careers with few buyer-facing pages. TierPoint has more service and cost pages for people comparing providers.
versus.Expedient: Published two webinar pages in 30 days, far less than TierPoint's 15 active pages, with a narrow Nutanix and AI product focus.
